concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's Evaluation step explicitly requires re-evaluating outputs with the three-tier metrics to calculate 'the shift in PR and the Integration-failure Rate (IR)'. The spec defines PR and HR (US-1, FR-003) but never defines, measures, or reports the Integration-failure Rate in any user story, FR, or SC. Constitution Principle VI also mandates that IR 'accurately reflects whether the model utilized the provided context'. Add IR as a measured metric (e.g., an FR/SC in US-2/US-3).

Minor drift/contradiction: the idea and Constitution VII say 'quantized or smaller open-source MLLMs where necessary', but the spec assumption states 'no ... 8-bit/4-bit quantization requiring specialized hardware is used'. CPU-side quantization is exactly the sanctioned resource strategy; reword to exclude only hardware-dependent quantization, not quantization generally, to avoid contradicting Constitution VII.
